# Email: Calendar Events

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the calendar-events extension for Caffeine AI apps: full CRUD for events/meetings plus iCalendar invitation delivery by email (`sendCalendarEvent` builds and attaches the .ics file per attendee). Includes UUID generation, attendee roles (chair / required / optional), and an admin-gated example with register, update, cancel and list endpoints. Depends on `caffeinelabs-extension-email`. Requires a Caffeine AI Plus or Pro subscription — there is no free tier for this skill. By @caffeinelabs, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: works only inside a Caffeine AI build (Internet Computer canister + Motoko); the skill states plainly that receiving RSVPs from attendees is not supported yet — invitations go out, replies don't come back. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
